author: Devin Lael Hartley
title: Seeking illustrator for VO T-shirt mockups
content:
Seeking artist recs! 🎨 Need an illustrator with indie-friendly rates to turn my VO T-Shirt mockups (Heroes, Villain, Monsters) into 100% human-made art. Drop your portfolio/rates below! 👇 Or DM me... I'm looking for style similar to my mockups.

Ideally, just the character for the villain, demon lord, and zombie. Then either just the character or full comic panels for the superhero and vigilante. These are for personal use only for marketing, not merchandise to be sold.

author: MizuSawa
title: Looking for artist for web novel concept art
content:
Hey y’all this is the first of MANY Updates on my romcom/SOL series, I thought it would be fun showing you the process of making a Web Novel. This art I have here is concept art of the main protagonist and the main heroine (I am looking for artist right now, dm if interested)

The basic plot is about a guy named Minoru Amari he’s your popular type of character who has a mask up all the time, hiding his true self and one day he meets this girl at his new part time job, a girl who has a personality he hates and along with that the girl hates Minoru’s personality. Eventually they get to talking more because of the job and he starts to open up to her a lot more breaking that mask he once had and decides to throw away “being popular” for just being himself and his life changes from here, making new bonds and connections but also losing some in the process.
